test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Amit starts from Point A and drives 35 km towards East. He then takes a right turn, drives 17 km, turns right and drives 15 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 13 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 20 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only unless otherwise specified.)
solution:
**Given: **

Amit starts from Point A and drives 35 km towards East.

He then takes a right turn, drives 17 km, turns right and drives 15 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 13 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 20 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70e5c83684f5b28a98b5488266289e0ba882d9820f67f4710431d62a65dee6ce.png] 

Thus, he drive 30 km towards North in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
